model: SIMOCODE pro V Modbus RTU basic unit
applies_to: SIMOCODE pro V Modbus RTU basic units, per Configuration Manual 04/2015 (A5E33498234002A/RS-AA/001).
summary: SIMOCODE pro V Modbus is a motor management and protection system whose basic unit has a built-in RS-485 Modbus RTU slave. Its data sets are mapped into one bit memory area (coils/discrete inputs) and one register memory area. This map covers the cyclic command and monitoring bits, motor currents, voltages and power, statistics and the device diagnostic bits.

addressing.note: Addresses are printed as hex offsets and sent unchanged as the start address. The manual's examples read device status bits with start address 0x1C08 (FC 01) and write the cooling-down period at 0x419A (FC 06). In a 1-based tool add 1 (0x0807 = 2055 -> 42056).

source.title: SIMOCODE pro Modbus RTU Configuration Manual
source.pages: commissioning pp. 15-18; function codes pp. 24-34; memory image and byte order pp. 37-38; process images pp. 39-40; measured values p. 41; statistics p. 42; diagnostics pp. 43-50

notes: Word order: the manual says data longer than one byte is stored big-endian (figure 4-1), so the D word values (power, operating hours, starts, energy) are high word first (ABCD).
Function codes 03 and 04 return the same register data, and 01 and 02 the same bit data; registers are listed as holding registers and read-only bits as discrete inputs.
The coil and input-bit assignments shown are the factory defaults of the process image; they can be reassigned in SIMOCODE ES.

Each diagnostic register 0x1C00-0x1C0F also holds 16 of the diagnostic bits (bit address = 0x1C00 + 16 x register offset + bit). Only the bit addresses are listed, because the manual's FC 01 example confirms them.

Left out: byte-packed values (thermal motor model, phase unbalance and cos phi in 0x0802-0x0803, permissible starts in 0x0C02), AM1 inputs, TM1 temperatures 1-3 and EM+ currents (no unit printed), error/event memory, trace data, I&M records and the device parameters from 0x4180 (parameter writes need the full tables on pp. 58-77).
Several operating-hour values are counted in seconds (unit 1 s) even though their name says hours.
The FC 03 example on p. 27 prints the start address of the currents as 0x07 although the text says 0x0807; the table address 0x0807 is used here.
Max per request: 2000 bits, 125 registers; the command image accepts at most 2 registers / 16 coils per access and measured values 16 registers.

integration.summary: Set the address (default 126) and baud (default 19200), then read holding registers 0x0806-0x081D for currents, voltages and power, and discrete inputs 0x1C08 onward for status. Control the motor through coils 0x0000-0x0002 (ON<, OFF, ON> in the default process image).
integration.enable: Set the Modbus address with the addressing plug (DIP switches 1-247, press TEST/RESET) or in SIMOCODE ES (Parameter > Modbus), together with baud rate, port configuration (8E1/8O1/8N2/8N1) and wait time. Remote control over the bus needs the operating mode Remote (mode selector S1 = 1 and S2 = 1).
integration.watchdog: Watchdog / watchdog time in the Modbus parameters: if no valid read or write arrives within the time, the unit restarts its baud search (auto baud) and, with Bus monitoring enabled, raises 'Fault - bus'. 'PLC/PCS monitoring' raises 'Fault - PLC/PCS' when its input (normally cyclic receive bit 0.7) drops in Remote mode.
quirks: Addresses are hex offsets sent as-is.
D words are big-endian, high word first.
Currents are percent of the set current Is, not amps.
setup: Default address 126, default baud 19200; 300-57600 baud or auto (4.8-57.6 kbps, needs the watchdog on).
RS-485 via terminals A/B/SPE or the 9-pin sub-D (alternatives, not both).
gotchas: A writable bit block cannot be written across read-only bits.
Auto baud detection works only with the watchdog enabled.
